records.question: How many days do I have to return an item?
records.answer: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 14 days of delivery.

records.question: How do I start a return?
records.answer: Go to My Account > Orders, select the order and click 'Return item'. Then print the prepaid return label and drop the parcel at any partner cargo branch.

records.question: When will I get my money back after returning something?
records.answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive the returned item.

records.question: How many days does standard delivery take?
records.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days.

records.question: Is shipping free?
records.answer: Shipping is free for orders over 500 TL, while smaller orders have a shipping fee of 49.90 TL.

records.question: Can you deliver to Germany?
records.answer: No. BilgiShop currently delivers only within Turkey.

records.question: Where can I see the status of my order?
records.answer: You can see the status of your order under My Account > Orders. We also email you a tracking number when your order ships.

records.question: Can I pay in instalments?
records.answer: Yes, credit card payments can be split into up to 6 instalments.

records.question: Do you accept bank transfer?
records.answer: Yes, we accept bank transfer along with credit and debit cards, and BilgiShop gift cards.

records.question: Is it safe to enter my card details?
records.answer: Yes, all card payments use 3D Secure verification, and BilgiShop does not store your full card number.

records.question: I forgot my password, what should I do?
records.answer: Click 'Forgot password' on the login page and enter your email address to receive a reset link. The reset link is valid for 1 hour.

records.question: Can I change the address of an order I just placed?
records.answer: Yes, but only before the order has shipped. You can do this by going to My Account > Orders and clicking 'Edit address'.

records.question: How can I close my account?
records.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Your account and personal data are removed within 30 days.

records.question: İade süresi kaç gün?
records.answer: Kullanılmamış ürünleri orijinal ambalajında teslim tarihinden itibaren 14 gün içinde iade edebilirsiniz.

records.question: Kargo ücreti ne kadar?
records.answer: 500 TL üzeri siparişlerde kargo ücretsizdir, daha küçük siparişlerde ise kargo ücreti 49.90 TL'dir.

records.question: Şifremi unuttum, ne yapmalıyım?
records.answer: Giriş sayfasındaki 'Şifremi unuttum' seçeneğine tıklayarak e-posta adresinizi girmeniz gerekmektedir. Gönderilen sıfırlama bağlantısı 1 saat geçerlidir.

records.question: Taksit yapabiliyor muyum?
records.answer: Evet, kredi kartı ödemelerinde 6 taksite kadar yapabilirsiniz.

records.question: Yurt dışına gönderim yapıyor musunuz?
records.answer: Hayır, BilgiShop şu anda yalnızca Türkiye içinde teslimat yapmaktadır.
